---
title: "03 - MR vs GIGASTROKE (any ischemic stroke)"
format: html
---

GIGASTROKE European ischemic stroke GWAS (`GCST90104540`; 62,100 cases / 1,234,808 controls), not indexed in OpenGWAS.
`get_raw("GIGASTROKE")` downloads the harmonised GWAS Catalog file (~0.4 GB). Instruments are matched by exact rsID
(no LD-proxy search), an asymmetry with MEGASTROKE stated as a limitation.

```{r setup}
source("00_setup.R")
exp_dat <- readRDS(need_file(file.path(DIR$proc, "exp_dat.rds"), "run 01_extract_exposure.qmd stage A"))
```

## Stage A - match and harmonise

```{r extract}
f_h <- file.path(DIR$proc, "dat_gigastroke_harmonised.rds")
if (RUN_EXTRACTION || !file.exists(f_h)) {
  full <- fread(get_raw("GIGASTROKE"))
  sub  <- as.data.frame(full[rsid %in% exp_dat$SNP]); rm(full); invisible(gc())
  cat("Instruments found by exact rsID:", nrow(sub), "of", nrow(exp_dat), "\n")
  out_dat <- format_data(sub, type = "outcome", snp_col = "rsid", beta_col = "beta", se_col = "standard_error",
                         effect_allele_col = "effect_allele", other_allele_col = "other_allele",
                         eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency", pval_col = "p_value", chr_col = "chromosome", pos_col = "base_pair_location")
  out_dat$outcome <- outcome_meta("GIGASTROKE")$label; out_dat$id.outcome <- "GCST90104540"
  saveRDS(harmonise_data(exposure_dat = exp_dat, outcome_dat = out_dat, action = 2), f_h)
}
```

## Stage B - analysis (offline)

```{r analysis}
dat <- readRDS(f_h)
cat("Harmonised rows:", nrow(dat), "| retained:", sum(dat$mr_keep), "| removed:", paste(dat$SNP[!dat$mr_keep], collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Instruments absent from GIGASTROKE:", length(setdiff(exp_dat$SNP, dat$SNP)), "\n")

b <- run_battery(dat, "GIGASTROKE")
print_battery(b)
b$res; b$het; b$pleio; b$presso_sum
```
